title: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) System — Overview and definition
t: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) System — Overview and definition
description: Manages every part, document, and change across a product's whole life.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Manages every part, document, and change across a product's whole life. A PLM system is the single source of truth for items, BOMs, CAD files, requirements, and change orders from concept to end-of-life. Real implementations include Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE, and open-source Aras Innovator. It enforces revision control, effectivity, and approval workflows across engineering, manufacturing, and service.
capabilities: Item, BOM, and document management with revision control
Engineering change workflow with impact analysis and approvals
Configuration and variant management with effectivity
CAD and requirements integration with traceability
Quality, compliance, and service-data linkage

title: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) System — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) System — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Manages every part, document, and change across a product's whole life.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) System, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Item, BOM, and document management with revision control). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Item, BOM, and document management with revision control and Engineering change workflow with impact analysis and approvals. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Engineering change-order management tool) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
